## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A twelve-fascicle compilation by the late-Tang commentator [如理](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%82%E7%90%86) (Rúlǐ) elaborating on [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA)'s [KR6n0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0026) *Chéng wéishí lùn shùjì* (T43n1830) — i.e. a *sub-commentary* on Kuījī's principal commentary, glossing the *shùjì* itself rather than the master text [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016). The "*jí*" 集 ("compiled") in the attribution indicates that Rúlǐ draws together multiple earlier sub-commentaries, including the second-generation Cí'ēn material of [慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC) and [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8), to elucidate Kuījī's text.

**Abstract**

The work is an important late-Tang representative of the third-generation Cí'ēn commentarial tradition. Where the second generation ([慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC) and [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8)) produced sub-commentaries on the master text itself, the third generation increasingly produced sub-commentaries on Kuījī's *shùjì*, treating it as a quasi-canonical text in its own right. Rúlǐ's *yìyǎn* is the most substantial extant example of this pattern; together with his shorter [KR6n0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0039) *yǎnmì shì*, it constitutes the principal late-Tang Cí'ēn corpus on the *Chéng wéishí lùn* commentarial tradition.

The dating bracket adopted (750–850) reflects scholarly uncertainty: the work post-dates [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8) (whose *yǎnmì* it draws on systematically) and pre-dates the late-Tang collapse of Cí'ēn institutional infrastructure following the Huìchāng 會昌 persecution of 845. The work survived in the *Xuzangjing* line but not in the Taishō.
